method: Authorized English-language X session. The registered Latest-search query was rerun for WesternJournalX with the frozen UTC window and post-type exclusions. search_exhaustion_note: The X search surface loaded successfully after the earlier throttle, but traversal stopped at 2026-08-25 and therefore did not cover the registered window start of 2026-08-22. The result is a recoverable lower bound, not a complete inventory, and cannot be used to freeze the sample.
